reasons: Position LTV 0.382 is well below the corridor act level 0.7 and target 0.5, with a 55.59% price drop to the 86% liquidation LTV - no deleveraging is warranted.

The only fired screen on the live market is ETH/USD staleness by 1 s (1201 s vs 1200 s max) with a positive answer; this de minimis breach should refresh on the next update and does not indicate an oracle failure.
The market itself is healthy: utilization 0.595 is below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.57%, pool sits within 0.15% of the oracle, and 5.27 loan tokens are available to borrow.
leave_market would not reduce feed risk: the backup market reads the same stale ETH/USD feed, and the demo market uses a team-set mock oracle.

Allowlisted text feeds report no open incident for these markets' oracles or pools; the Base Denim upgrade is scheduled for later today (18:00-20:00 UTC) with the network expected to remain operational, so no critical text-path condition exists.
Sale budget (0.001667 WETH remaining) and move limits are untouched, but with LTV already under target, selling collateral would only push toward the 0.3 floor for no risk benefit.

items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
